## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X329 in four fascicles is [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s phrase-by-phrase commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670), paired with the *[xuányì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345)* (X328). The pair structurally mirrors the Tiāntái-school's commentarial doublet on its principal sūtras (*xuányì* + *wénjù*); [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) adapted that pattern from the Tiāntái master tradition to the *Laṅkāvatāra*.

**Abstract**

Date bracket follows [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s late productive period at Língfēngsì 靈峯寺 (1635–1655). The *yìshū* draws on the doctrinal programme laid out in the *xuányì* and applies it lemma-by-lemma to the parent sūtra. The commentary is doctrinally syncretic in [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s characteristic late-Míng manner — Yogācāra, Tathāgatagarbha, Chán, Tiāntái, and Pure-Land categories all engaged as the parent sūtra warrants — and is one of the most thorough monastic commentaries on T670 produced in the late imperial period.

X328 + X329 + Hānshān's [X326](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343) + [曾鳳儀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%BE%E9%B3%B3%E5%84%80)'s [X330](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0347) + [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4)'s [X331](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348) together represent the late-Míng *Laṅkāvatāra* commentarial canon, constituted within roughly one generation of monastic and lay scholars in the Wànlì–Chóngzhēn–early-Qīng transition.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); paired commentary [KR6i0345](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345) (楞伽經玄義 / X328).
